## Personality

A capable, kind, and hard-working person, Rachel Lynde is known for her skill in making homemade butter and cheese. She is notably observant, farseeing, and considers herself a strong judge of human nature. Very outspoken and often critical, she prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor, though she is honest enough to own up when she makes a mistake. Pious and fond of being asked for advice, she is also opposed to the higher education of women.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who raised ten children and buried two. When she learned [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) planned to adopt an orphan boy, she voiced strong disapproval over the risks involved. After meeting the young orphan [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Mrs. Rachel offended her with blunt remarks about her red hair, but she completely forgiven the girl after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offered a dramatic apology. Over time, Mrs. Rachel became a trusted advisor to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) on raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), counselled her to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home after a school incident, and helped [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) acquire a puffed-sleeve dress for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

## Quotes

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "I was kind of afraid you weren’t, though, when I saw Matthew starting off today. I thought maybe he was going to the doctor’s."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014)

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

> "I don’t know it. I guess you’re going to teach right here in Avonlea. The trustees have decided to give you the school."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel initially clashed with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after insulting her physical appearance, causing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a rage. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a dramatic apology, Rachel completely forgiven her and offered her flowers, leading to a friendly relationship. Rachel has since offered practical advice regarding Anne's upbringing, such as letting her stay home from school to cool off, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) even confides her mistakes to Rachel before making amends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), +15 more_

- Friend of — reconciled after apology  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P12](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0012)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Rachel are neighboring friends who frequently visit one another. Rachel often shares her outspoken opinions on Marilla's household decisions, such as expressing strong disapproval over the Cuthberts' plan to adopt an orphan. Despite occasional friction over Anne's behavior, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) trusts Rachel's judgment and consults her for practical advice on raising the young girl, and the two even travel together to events like political rallies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), +17 more_
